mapper.select: select i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.order_no,o.member_id,s.spu_id,i.sku_id, i.product_name,i.sku_name,i.product_image,i.quantity, r.review_id,r.status review_status, case when r.review_id is null then 1 else 0 end can_review from mall_order_item i join mall_order o on o.order_id=i.order_id and o.member_id=#{memberId} and o.status='COMPLETED' and o.payment_status='PAID' join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=i.sku_id left join mall_product_review r on r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id where i.order_item_id=#{orderItemId}

select i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.order_no,o.member_id,s.spu_id,i.sku_id, i.product_name,i.sku_name,i.product_image,i.quantity, r.review_id,r.status review_status, case when r.review_id is null then 1 else 0 end can_review from mall_order_item i join mall_order o on o.order_id=i.order_id and o.member_id=#{memberId} and o.status='COMPLETED' and o.payment_status='PAID' join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=i.sku_id left join mall_product_review r on r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id where o.order_id=#{orderId} order by i.order_item_id

select count(1) reviewCount, coalesce(round(avg(rating),2),0) averageRating, sum(case when rating=5 then 1 else 0 end) fiveStarCount, sum(case when rating=4 then 1 else 0 end) fourStarCount, sum(case when rating=3 then 1 else 0 end) threeStarCount, sum(case when rating=2 then 1 else 0 end) twoStarCount, sum(case when rating=1 then 1 else 0 end) oneStarCount from mall_product_review where spu_id=#{spuId} and status='PUBLISHED'

select , case when r.anonymous='1' then '匿名用户' else coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''), concat(left(m.phone,3),'****',right(m.phone,4))) end reviewer_name from mall_product_review r join mall_member m on m.member_id=r.member_id where r.spu_id=#{spuId} and r.status='PUBLISHED' order by r.create_time desc,r.review_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select image_url from mall_product_review_image where review_id=#{reviewId} order by sort_no,review_image_id

select ,m.phone member_phone, case when r.anonymous='1' then '匿名用户' else coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''), concat(left(m.phone,3),'****',right(m.phone,4))) end reviewer_name from mall_product_review r join mall_member m on m.member_id=r.member_id where r.review_id=#{reviewId}
mapper.update: update mall_product_review set status=#{status},audit_by=#{auditBy},audit_time=now(),audit_remark=#{remark},update_time=now() where review_id=#{reviewId} and status='PENDING'
